mountains.placement_code: if(LAND[id]){let bw=0;for(const r of REGIONS){const dx=x-r.x,dz=z-r.z;const w=Math.exp(-((dx*dx)/(r.rx*r.rx)+(dz*dz)/(r.rz*r.rz))*2.0);if(w>bw){bw=w;b=r.id;}}}
